description.pt: Agente do Google, sucessor do Gemini CLI.
description.en: Google's agent, successor to Gemini CLI.

acp.command: bash -c 'f=/root/.local/share/agy-acp/agy_acp_server.par; if [ "$(head -c 4 "$f" | tail -c 3)" = ELF ]; then exec "$f" --uid=; else exec python3 "$f" --uid=; fi'
acp.install: mkdir -p ~/.local/share/agy-acp && cd ~/.local/share/agy-acp && curl -fsSL -o agy-acp.zip https://dl.google.com/agy-extensions/releases/linux/agy-acp-server-1.4.4-linux-arm64.zip && echo 'b0273227c07cfa1ea5c1d9ff869b64c5b2b39b98862081fcd4c597ec316e0c57  agy-acp.zip' | sha256sum -c - && unzip -o -q agy-acp.zip && rm agy-acp.zip && chmod +x agy_acp_server.par

note.pt: O chat do Antigravity é experimental: usa o servidor ACP que o Google distribui à parte.
note.en: Antigravity chat is experimental: it uses the ACP server Google ships separately.
